subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party core `rescueWatchdog` cron/service-control recovery feature in this PR after a rebase, or defer that work to the broader gateway recovery design?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: the PR adds core recovery behavior, service-control command execution, and protocol surface that needs maintainer ownership and live proof.

options.title: Require rebase and proof first
options.body: Ask for the branch to be rebased onto current cron/protocol contracts and for redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before deciding final product acceptance.

options.title: Split out daemon hardening
options.body: Extract the launchd/service-control hardening into a smaller PR while leaving the watchdog product direction on the canonical recovery issue.

options.title: Defer core watchdog work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want a core rescue watchdog surface now.

recommendation.title: Require rebase and proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for the branch to be rebased onto current cron/protocol contracts and for redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before deciding final product acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: He has current cron/protocol history and is the best available owner for the product-direction decision among the likely owners.
